canonical_project: Royal Group Elite DC1 / Telcotech Data Center
notes: Telcotech's flagship Phnom Penh colocation facility, Royal Group Elite DC1, earned Uptime Institute Tier III Certification of Design Documents (TCDD), announced 18 July 2025. Carrier-neutral with dual A+B feeds, N+1 UPS, backup generators and precision cooling; scalable from single racks to enterprise suites. Public MW capacity not disclosed. Telcotech is a member of AAG and MCT submarine cable consortia and listed a $20M bond on CSX partly to fund data center infrastructure.
